multiple_testing_policy.population_boundary: Repeated splits reuse one fixed labelled sample; adjusted p-values describe conditional split stability and do not establish population generalisation.
multiple_testing_policy.primary_family: Six two-sided main-sample repeat-level comparisons: hand-crafted versus transaction-only and hand-crafted+Node2Vec versus hand-crafted, across three models.
multiple_testing_policy.secondary_family: Nine coarse-baseline and EOA-scope repeat-level comparisons; adjusted but retained as exploratory scope checks.

shap_interpretation.correlated_feature_rule: Interpret correlated components and transaction/structural group totals before individual ranks; attribution can be redistributed among associated predictors.
